title: Cargo manifest declares no licence
description: Cargo.toml declares a crate manifest that records no licence. Redistribution rights cannot be established from the manifest, which blocks release review and downstream use.
remediation: Declare `license` (SPDX) or `license-file`, and include the file in the package.
limitation: It matches a crate manifest that records no licence in the parsed Cargo.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
